notes: TRUST-1843 builds the tvOS QR-pairing consent loop locally. Two surfaces: (A) consent-test-server (FastAPI, uv) lives INSIDE this knowledgebase repo at output/universal/test-server/ — feat-001..004, Linux-native, self-verifiable in-VM; (B) consent-ios (Swift/tvOS) at ~/proj/consent-ios — feat-005..009, Swift cannot compile in a Linux shuru VM, so the agent makes edits+commits only and the human verifies via xcodebuild on the host. The static phone page reads user_hash/customer_id/config_url from the querystring; NO pairing-session subsystem; SDK polls (server also exposes SSE keyed on user_hash). GPC reconciliation is CLIENT-SIDE only — server never reconciles.
